text_block_list.text:
At last, the curtains on the Arima Kinen
rise. This
will be the finale of Fuji
Kiseki's four-part
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd sends her off in a sea of
unending
cheers. She tells me how
thankful she is that I've
been there for
her all this time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She goes off to run in the race. She's
more
dazzling than she's ever been and
is the most
brilliant star in the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
